infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Rally uses your approximate location only during an active session you start, and only when you choose to share it with your group.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Optional. Lets Rally keep recording your activity if the screen locks. You can stop sharing at any time.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Rally reads workouts, heart rate, steps, distance, and active energy from Apple Health only after you connect a device. You can disconnect and delete imported data at any time.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Rally can save completed Rally sessions back to Apple Health if you choose to.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Rally uses motion data to estimate steps and movement quality during phone-based sessions.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow Rally to keep recording if your screen locks. You can stop at any time.
